displayIdentity.body: Differing roles lead toward a more excellent way. God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages. But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
displayIdentity.title: Differing roles lead toward a more excellent way
